# Payload Contract Checklist: Hosted ZIP MIME Compatibility

**Purpose**: Review the ZIP compatibility requirements for an exact allowlist, fail-closed body validation, diagnostic clarity, and regression coverage
**Created**: 2026-09-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Allowlist Boundaries

- [x] CHK001 Are the two accepted normalized ZIP media types stated exactly and exhaustively? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are wildcard, substring, and generic binary media-type fallbacks clearly excluded? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK003 Is the existing treatment of casing, parameters, and whitespace specified for the new alias? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Edge Cases]

## Fail-Closed Archive Evidence

- [x] CHK004 Does the spec require archive-structure evidence independently of an accepted media type? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK005 Are empty, HTML, malformed, truncated, opening-signature-only, and end-record-only bodies addressed? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 Is a valid archive with an unsupported media type explicitly required to fail? [Exception Coverage, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK007 Is the existing maximum ZIP comment boundary preserved without weakening the end-record rule? [Boundary Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Shared Verification and Diagnostics

- [x] CHK008 Is it explicit that local and production-origin verification use the same corrected contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK009 Are metadata and body failures required to remain distinguishable and objectively reviewable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK010 Are non-ZIP contracts explicitly protected from behavioral change? [Scope, Spec §FR-008]

## Acceptance Coverage

- [x] CHK011 Does the required regression matrix cover valid and malformed bodies under both supported media types? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, SC-001, SC-002]
- [x] CHK012 Does the required regression matrix cover valid archive bytes under unsupported media types? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, SC-003]
- [x] CHK013 Are local suite, full site suite, and live production-origin completion signals distinct and measurable? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004, SC-005]
- [x] CHK014 Are source and artifact boundaries explicit enough to prevent generated downloads or identity files from entering scope? [Scope, Spec §FR-010, SC-006]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
